content: Dórmor dinor babute suwal
Hono ek dórmor din Isaye fõtot hono ek gĩyuketi bai gil. Isar sahabi okkole giyũrdanar sora siri hatot góši góši há šuru goijje.
Hetunot hozon forošiye hodde, "Ain mozin dórmor din zin gora mana hin kiyolla goror?"
Isaye hodde:

content.text: "Daud edde hibar fũwajja okkolottu zehon buk laggil hẽtte ki goijje hin ki tũwara no foro?
Hibaye to Allar górot goillil, edde sarme rakkilde ruṭi loi háil edde hibar fũwajja okkolore dil, zin šude imam okkole haibar ain ase."

content: Bade Isaye he Foroši okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Adomor Fut oilde dórmor dinor malik."

content: Ar ek dórmor din Isaye sinagogot giye edde šikka diye. Heṛe en ekzon manuš aššil zar ḍen hat mozigiyegoi.
Dórmiyo alem okkol edde Foroši okkole, Isaye dórmor din he manušware aram gore ki no gore hiyan saibolla, hitara Isar uwore bala bafe nozor raikke. Toi zene hitara Isare hosuri dibar haron tuwai fa.
Kintu Isaye hitarar monor sinta zainto. Hetolla he hat mozi giyegoide manušware Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Uṛi beggunor munttu ai tiya!"

content: Henot hite uṛi tiyaiye.
Isaye dórmiyo alem okkol edde Foroši okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare ekkan hota fusar gori, dórmor din ki gora ezajot ase? Bala ham gora ne naki horaf ham gora? Foran basa ne naki foran dongšo gora?"

content: Tarfore Isaye sairo ḍakor beggunor mikka sai manušware hodde:

content.text: "Tor hattan mum mikka ṭan."

content: Hite hen goijjebar hitar hattan ekkubare bala oi giyegoi.
Hetunot hitara guššaye heṛe uzora uzori oi giyegoi edde Isare ki gora zaibo he babute hitara hitara biyasana goijje.
Isaye he barozonore asab oibolla ḍaikke
He din okkolot ekdin hiba munazat goribolla ek faharor uwore uiṭṭe, edde heṛe hibaye Allar hãse munazat gorat šara rait haṛai diye.
Bade binna zehon oiye, hibaye hibar šahabi okkolore ḍaikke edde hitarar butottu barozonore basi loiye, zarare asab hoi nam diye:
Simon, zare Isaye Fitor hoi nam diye edde hitar bái Andreas, Yakub, Yuhanna, Filip, Bartolomeus,
Moti Ṭomas, Alfeusor fuwa Yakub, Simon, zare bahadur Zelot hoito,
Yakubor fut Ehudah, edde Ehudah Iskariyot, ze Isare dušmon okkolor hatot dori diye.
Isaye šikka diye edde biyaram bala goijje

Hibaye hitarare fũwati loi faharottu abar lami giye edde ekkan fuwainna zagat tiyaiye. Heṛe hibar ek ḍõr sahabi okkol edde Šara Ehudiyattu, Zeruzalem edde doriyar hãsar Sidon edde Tirosottu o aro bout beši manuš okkol,
zara heṛe hibar boyan funibolla edde biyaramottu aram oibolla heṛe aišše. Ar zara napak ruh loi duk fail, hitarare o hibaye bala goijje.
Edde hár mainše hibare suibolla kušiš goijje, kiyollahoile hibar butottu ek šokti niyoli gil edde harkiyore aram goijjil.
Bala edde burar babute šikka
Isaye sahabi okkolor uzu suk tuli hodde:

content.text: "Allar rahamot tũwarar uwore zara gorib,
Allar raijjo tũwarar.
Allar rahamot tũwarar uwore zara ehon waišša,
tũwarar buk miṭa oibo.
Allar rahamot tũwarar uwore zara ehon handor,
tũwara hašiba.
Allar rahamot tũwarar uwore, zẽtte Adomor Futolla buli,
mainše tũwarare hingša gore,
tũwarare šomazottu niyolai de, ar ofoman gore,
edde tũwarar nam horaf hoi tũwarare batil gore.
"He dinot anondo goro edde kušiye fal maro, kiyollahoile, so, behostot tũwaralla enam beši ḍõr. Kiyollahoile hitarar bafdada okkole o nobi okkolor loi endilla bebohar okkol gorito.
"Kintu bifod tũwarare, zara tuwangor,
tũwara tũwarar šantona faifelaiyo.
Bifod tũwarare zara ehon feṭ borai faror
tũwarattu buk lagibo.
Bifod tũwarare zara ehon hašor,
tũwara bilak goriba edde handiba.
Bifod tũwarar, zẽtte hár mainše tũwarare šunam gore.
Hitarar bafdada okkole o bonḍo nobi okkolore hendilla goitto.

content: Dušmonore o muhabbot goro

content.text: "Kintu tũwara zara funor ãi hitarare hoir: Tũwarar dušmonore o muhabbot goro, zara tũwarare hingša gore hitarare balai goro.
Zara tũwarare bodduwa de, hitarare duwa goro. Zara tũwarare ninda gore hitaralla munazat goro.
Ze tũwar ek galot suwar mare, hitar mikka oinno galo lagai diyo, ar ze tũwar saddor kuli lor, hitare bazu kuli loite o mana no goijjo.
Ar ze honokiye tũwattu kissu sa, hitare diyo, edde ze honokiye tũwarar hono kissu loi za, hin ar uwafes no saiyo.
"Funo, mainše tũwarare zendilla gorok aša goro, tũwara o hitarar loi hendilla bebohar goro.
"Ar zara tũwarare muhabbot gore, šudu hitarare muhabbot gorile tũwara ki gun faiba? Hendilla muhabbot to horaf mainše o gori take.
Ar zara tũwarar ufohar gore, šudu zodi hitarar ufohar goro, toile tũwara ki gun faiba? Hendilla to gunagar mainše o gore.
Ar zarar hãsottu uwafes faibar aša take, hali zodi hitarare udar do, toile tũwara ki gun faiba? Horaf mainše o horaf manuš okkolore udar de, zene hedun firaifa.

Kintu tũwara nizor dušmonore o muhabbot goro edde hitarar balai goro. Uwafes faibar aša no raki udar do. Toile tũwarar enam ḍõr oibo edde tũwara šorbo šoktiwala Allar fuwain oiba. Haron Allah našukur edde horafore o doya gore.
Tũwarar behostiyo Baf zendilla rahamoti, tũwara o hendilla rahamoti o.

content: Duši no goijjo

content.text: "Ar tũwara bisar no goijjo, henot tũwarare o bisar gora no oibo. Duši no goijjo, henot tũwarare o duši gora no oibo. Tũwara sari do, henot tũwarare o sari diya oibo.
Dan goro, henot tũwarare o diya oibo. Beši forimane sibi sibi, zankai zankai, zaf di forefan gori tũwarar kulot diya oibo, kiyollahoile tũwara ze bafe mafi do, he bafe tũwaralla o mafa oibo."

content: Ar hibaye ekkan boson o hoiye:

content.text: "Ekzon andaye ki ar ekzon andare fõt dehai faribo? Dunizon gorot fori no zaiboi ne?
Šagirit ustator uwore no, kintu ze furafuri šikka fa, hite hitar ustator ḍoilla o.
"Ar tũwar báiyor sukot ze hal ase hiyan kiyolla dekor, kintu tũwar nizor sukot ze gasor ḍõr seli ase hiyan kiyolla bafi no sor?

Tũwar sukot ze gasor seli ase hiyan zehon no dekor, toile tũi ken gori ar ekzonore hoi faror, 'Bái aiyo, ãi tũwar sukottu hallan loifelai, 'Oh munafek! Age nizor sukor gasor ḍõr seli hiyan loifela, toi bade tor báiyor sukot ze hal ase hiyan loi felaibolla foriškar gori dekibi.

content: Gas edde gula

content.text: "Bala gasot horaf gula dorede hendilla hono hota nai, ar hendilla horaf gasot o bala gula no dore.
Gula sai gas sinaza. Mainše keṛarzalittu ḍuirgula ba kẽṛagasottu ãngur no tule.
Bala manuše hitar dil boraiya balattu bala hota bair gori ane, ar horaf mainše hitar dil furaiya horafottu horaf hota bair gori ane, kiyollahoile zar dil zine furaiya, hitar gale hin ho.

content: Mojbut gór edde mojbut node gór

content.text: "Tũwara ãre Malik, Malik hoi ka ḍako, ãi ziyan hoi hiyan zodi no goro?
Ze honokiye ãr hãse aiye, ãr hota fune edde he mozin gore, hite hár ḍoilla ãi tũwarare dehai.

Hite en ekzon manušor ḍoilla, ze gór bandibolla murgori meṛi kuijje edde fattoror uwore faiya gãijje. Bade he góror uwore boinna aišše edde ḍollor fani aišše, to górganore lari no fare, kiyollahoile hiyan mujbut gori banda oiye.
Ar ze ãr hota fune, kintu he mozin no gore, hite en ekzon manušor ḍoilla, ze faiya no gãri meṛir uwore gór bainde. Bade he górot ḍollor fani aišše, hetunot he górgan fori ekkubare dongšo oi giyegoi."
